protocol.H_definition: Receiver-native original thinking prompt cache plus mapped reasoning suffix at original absolute positions; includes native prompt prefill.
protocol.P_definition: Same original public prompt; pinned enable_thinking=False chat template with empty <think> section, no separate reasoning. Prefill ids[:-1] and use ids[-1:] as exact final-template bridge, as v2.

budgets.cap_failure: Preserve capped/early-EOS histories and answers. Never drop, extend selectively or replace a hard task. Oversized original prompt is an explicit protocol failure; do not crop.

protocol.cache_isolation: Immutable history/base states; clone private cache and independent RNG for each condition/seed. Preserve native/native reinjection/splice controls and actual partial-native rounding diagnostics, exact original positions, no alias/mutation, model/runtime/history/checkpoint hashes.

decoding.policy: Same thinking-mode sampling through reasoning and final answer. Do not switch to non-thinking template at the boundary.

protocol.handoff: At natural closing-think emission, cache excludes emitted closing token and bridge contains exactly that token. For a capped history, preserve every sampled reasoning token and feed one prespecified closing token. Original absolute positions; no new user turn; free answers contain no source-written final-answer prefix. Preserve natural code in reasoning.

resource_estimate.existing_jobs: do not cancel healthy unrelated/secondary work or duplicate scheduler
resource_estimate.hard_cap: must independently verify owner amendment and remaining ledger
resource_estimate.profile_rule: project504 full answers from calibrated actual oracle overhead/length; stop dispatch and report concrete blocker if disproportionate, notify if material expansion needed; never silently change sparsity
resource_estimate.telemetry: warning-based memory, atomic progress, bounded recovery and verified backup
resource_estimate.useful_parallelism: independent task/condition groups on small compatible fleet after calibration; reuse immutable caches safely

sample_rule.selection: rank0 calibration; ranks1,2,3 screen; others retained in population audit
sample_rule.within_stratum_rank: SHA256 UTF8(sparse_repair_01|20260921|task_id) ascending hex; tie task_id

scope: Exploratory diagnosis on already-inspected development tasks; not confirmation or a deployable speedup.

scorer.runtime_note: Pinned corrected scorer is Linux chroot/unprivileged UID/syscall allowlist, not the earlier Phase2 macOS grader. Requires existing isolated CPU environment or validated recreation. Mac Studio is not a silent candidate-scoring substitute. CPU environment availability must be checked by provider controller.

seed_derivation: Existing confirmation seed_for: first8 SHA256(coding_pilot_v1|task_id|0|stream), big-endian modulo2**63; distinct streams identify the3 draws; worker order excluded.

selector.N_M: mask unselected reasoning and renormalize actual arm attention over retained entries
selector.R: immutable mapped reasoning background plus current native replacements; recompute actual repaired attention, never reuse oracle weights or permanently accumulate repairs
selector.budget: k=ceil(p*historical_reasoning_positions), identical k per layer/KV-head group; complete K/V pairs
selector.comparison: N/M/R share scoring rule; only identical queries imply identical selected positions
selector.label: ORACLE-ASSISTED
selector.normalization: native prompt/reasoning plus this treatment's own current/generated answer positions; causal mask; never future tokens
selector.outside_budget: entire original native prompt, current token and own answer states stay present
selector.position_policy: retain original absolute positions/RoPE; no token packing or shifting
selector.random: seed from first8 big-endian bytes SHA256 compact JSON(['sparse-repair-01-random-v1',task_id,draw_seed,layer,step,kv_head]) modulo2**63; CPU torch.Generator randperm under pinned runtime; exact same k, sorted ascending selected positions
selector.ranking: descending FP32 native mass; stable ties lower original absolute position
selector.recent: k highest original reasoning positions at every layer/group
selector.scope: each current query, attention layer and KV-head group independently
selector.score: native historical keys with current treatment query; sum native attention probabilities across query heads sharing KV head
